risk_flags.description: The requester asked for a broad improvement, but the contract narrows that to counts and percentages without confirming those are the desired usefulness improvements. This may be fine, but it should be confirmed before implementation.
risk_flags.span: Can you make them more useful?

risk_flags.description: The contract promises category counts while also excluding changes to the category totals API; if that API is the only source of category data, this constraint could make the promised output awkward or impossible without duplicating logic.
risk_flags.span: No changes to the `category_totals` function signature or return type

verdict.primary_risk: The main risk is that the contract turns a vague usefulness request into a specific count-and-percentage design without requester confirmation.
